title: pera distichophylla var. laurina
intro: Pera distichophylla var. laurina, commonly known as Laurina Pera, is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Laurina Pera include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
